item.title: Show HN: Encore – Type-safe back end framework that generates infra from code
item.description:

item.title: V8 Garbage Collector
item.description:
📝 the last couple years in v8's garbage collectorLet’s talk about memory management. The sandbox also uses some 40-bit offsets for references to larger objects, with similar guarantees. Some objects that should never be directly referenced by user code go in a separate “trusted space”, which is outside the sandbox.
🔗 Read more: https://wingolog.org/archives/2025/11/13/the-last-couple-years-in-v8s-garbage-collector

item.title: Gnome 50 Ends the X11 Era After Decades
item.description:
📝 Now that Gnome has dropped X11 support, I will no longer be able to use Gnome. I have software that doesn’t run in Wayland or Xwayland. Polybar now supports Wayand but doesn’t run in Gnome because Gnome doesn’t support all the necessary protocols.
🔗 Read more: https://linuxiac.com/gnome-50-ends-the-x11-era-after-decades/
